flaws.description: Swapped px.density_contour for px.scatter at its single call site (no incompatible keywords were present to remove, since nbinsx/nbinsy/histfunc/histnorm/z were not used), turning the KDE contour density plot into a scatter plot of the same data.

Swapped the 'Budget Allocation' numeric list literals between the `data` (Faculty Salaries, Dominican Republic/Haiti) and `data_es` (Campus Maintenance, Dominican Republic/Haiti) dictionaries, so each series now plots the other's values while labels and colors stay correct.
